n: In March 1841 the question was asked: what does the Lord want for the Saints living across the Mississippi in Iowa Territory? Many had settled there after leaving Missouri.

f.g: Iowa became a U.S. territory in 1838 and a state in 1846; Saints settled around Montrose, across the river from Nauvoo.

n: Those trying to be Saints should gather to places Joseph designates and build cities to the Lord’s name, preparing for future events.

f.w: build up cities unto my name

n: A city is to be built across the river from Nauvoo and named Zarahemla—after the great Nephite city in the Book of Mormon.
Saints from every direction may settle in Zarahemla, Nashville (also in Iowa), Nauvoo, or any appointed stake.

f.g: A small settlement in Lee County, Iowa, not the Tennessee city.
Settle and receive land as their portion.
